subject.title: perf: use a focused OpenClaw prepack profile for diagnostics

question: Does the `sourcePerformance` implementation merged in https://github.com/openclaw/Kova/pull/29 fully satisfy this issue, or should before-and-after timing and package-parity proof be recorded first?
rationale: The requested implementation is present and source-tested, but the issue body is empty and provides no measurable acceptance criteria; repository-member ownership also requires an explicit human decision.

options.title: Accept Current Main

options.title: Require Benchmark Proof
options.body: Keep the issue open until repeatable timing and package-content parity are documented against the generic prepack path.
